metas.name: Parks and Recreation
metas.description: Since you enjoyed Ted Lasso and The Good Place, this series offers a similar blend of optimistic humor and a strong ensemble cast.

metas.name: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
metas.description: This features the fast-paced, witty ensemble dynamic found in New Girl and Community.

metas.name: Arrested Development
metas.description: Like Community and It's Always Sunny, this show relies on intricate, meta-humor and a highly dysfunctional group of characters.

metas.name: 30 Rock
metas.description: As an SNL fan, you will appreciate this fast-paced, satirical look at the behind-the-scenes of a variety show.

metas.name: Archer
metas.description: Matches the sharp, adult-oriented humor of Rick and Morty and the high-concept world-building of Futurama.

metas.name: What We Do in the Shadows
metas.description: Like Dirk Gently and It's Always Sunny, this mockumentary offers a bizarre, supernatural, and hilarious subversion of tropes.

metas.name: Spaced
metas.description: A British cult classic that aligns with the pop-culture obsession of Community and the dry British wit of Peep Show.

metas.name: Taskmaster
metas.description: Since you enjoy Gogglebox and British comedy, this reality competition is pure, lighthearted entertainment with a revolving door of comedians.

metas.name: Schitt's Creek
metas.description: A perfect comfort watch that transitions from cynical to heartwarming, much like the journey in Ted Lasso.

metas.name: Veep
metas.description: If you liked the fast-talking, tech-world cynicism of Silicon Valley, you will love this sharp political satire.

metas.name: Mythic Quest
metas.description: Created by the Sunny team and set in a tech environment, it's a natural next step after Silicon Valley and Community.

metas.name: Mob Psycho 100
metas.description: From the creator of One-Punch Man, it offers spectacular animation with a lighthearted, comedic take on psychic powers.

metas.name: The IT Crowd
metas.description: A foundational British sitcom for anyone who liked Silicon Valley or Peep Show.

metas.name: Black Books
metas.description: Pairs perfectly with Peep Show as a darkly funny, cynical British comedy about antisocial misfits.

metas.name: Peacemaker
metas.description: Combines the irreverent, over-the-top action of One-Punch Man with the character-driven humor of Rick and Morty.

metas.name: The Great British Bake Off
metas.description: The ultimate low-stakes 'comfort' show to match your Gogglebox preference.

metas.name: Broad City
metas.description: A hilarious, energetic look at friendship that fans of New Girl and Master of None will appreciate.

metas.name: Ghosts
metas.description: The British original is a charming, funny, and lighthearted ensemble piece that fits the 'Good Place' vibe.

metas.name: Party Down
metas.description: A hidden gem featuring a cynical service crew that echoes the workplace humor of Silicon Valley and It's Always Sunny.

metas.name: Better Off Ted
metas.description: A high-concept corporate satire that fits the clever, snappy writing style of Community.

metas.name: Star Trek: Lower Decks
metas.description: An animated sci-fi comedy that captures the irreverence of Futurama and Rick and Morty within a beloved franchise.

metas.name: The Venture Bros.
metas.description: A brilliant parody of action-adventure tropes that mirrors the meta-commentary found in Community and Rick and Morty.

metas.name: Plebs
metas.description: A British 'lads in Rome' sitcom that shares the DNA of Brassic and Peep Show.

metas.name: Stath Lets Flats
metas.description: If you enjoy the awkward, cringe-based humor of Peep Show, this property-agent comedy is a must-watch.

metas.name: Spy x Family
metas.description: A lighthearted, action-packed anime that provides the same 'fun adventure' feeling as ONE PIECE.

metas.name: Avenue 5
metas.description: Created by Armando Iannucci, this blends the sci-fi setting of Futurama with the workplace panic of Silicon Valley.

metas.name: Our Flag Means Death
metas.description: A funny, heartwarming pirate adventure that aligns with the whimsical nature of ONE PIECE and Ted Lasso.

metas.name: Shrinking
metas.description: Co-created by the Ted Lasso team and featuring the medical comedy-drama roots of Scrubs.

metas.name: Lodge 49
metas.description: A wonderfully laid-back, surreal comedy-drama that captures the 'holistic' oddness of Dirk Gently.

metas.name: Cougar Town
metas.description: From the creator of Scrubs, this show evolves into a warm, hilarious ensemble comedy about a group of friends who just want to hang out.

metas.name: Happy Endings
metas.description: A faster, joke-dense version of New Girl that focuses on a tightly-knit, eccentric friend group.

metas.name: Flight of the Conchords
metas.description: Like Master of None, this uses music and deadpan humor to explore the lives of two struggling artists.

metas.name: Catastrophe
metas.description: A witty, honest, and very funny British-American sitcom that fans of Master of None and Brassic will enjoy.

metas.name: Misfits
metas.description: A gritty yet very funny British show about young offenders with superpowers, matching the energy of Brassic and Dirk Gently.

metas.name: Workaholics
metas.description: Captures the same 'slackers getting into trouble' energy found in It's Always Sunny and Silicon Valley.

metas.name: Psych
metas.description: A light, fun procedural with a bromance dynamic that will remind you of the best moments in Scrubs.

metas.name: Abbott Elementary
metas.description: A heartwarming, highly-rated mockumentary that provides the same comfort levels as Parks and Recreation.

metas.name: Kim's Convenience
metas.description: A low-stress, character-driven family sitcom that makes for perfect 'background' or 'comfort' viewing.

metas.name: The Mick
metas.description: Starring Kaitlin Olson from It's Always Sunny, it brings that same chaotic, mean-spirited but hilarious energy to a family setting.

metas.name: Unbreakable Kimmy Schmidt
metas.description: From the 30 Rock team, this is an incredibly colorful, fast-paced, and uplifting comedy that fits the 'light' filter perfectly.
